summary: Our 50-Hour Multi Style Yoga Course is suitable for all levels, including beginners, intermediate practitioners, and advanced students.
intro: Immerse yourself in a transformative journey at our 50 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Uluwatu, Bali—a sanctuary where ancient wisdom harmonizes with contemporary practice. Designed for yoga enthusiasts eager to deepen their practice or embark on a teaching path, this condensed program offers profound growth without the demands of longer trainings. Whether you’re a dedicated student seeking inner expansion or an aspiring teacher ready to share yoga’s gifts, our curriculum bridges traditional techniques and modern methodologies, guiding you beyond asana into yoga’s rich philosophy and holistic essence.

Our 50 hour program is crafted as a transformational stepping stone, blending focused learning modules with the flexibility modern life demands. Set against Bali’s serene backdrop, this immersive experience balances theory and practice, offering a holistic foundation in yoga—perfect for deepening your personal journey or igniting a teaching path.

Discover the freedom to begin or expand your yoga journey with our 50 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Uluwatu, Bali. Whether you're testing the waters of teaching or deepening your practice, this program offers a stepping stone to higher certifications. Complete this training and seamlessly progress to our 100 Hour Advanced Modules, building toward a comprehensive certification at your own pace.

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. By following a plant-based diet during your training, you are in the practice of ahimsa.
mealTimes: Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

prerequisites: A high level of self-motivation is essential for all aspects of the course. The practice, and especially the teaching of yoga, require a strong sense of self-discipline and purity.

policies.title: Discipline Rules
items: Always maintain discipline, respect the teachers, and follow all rules.
Always be on time; late arrivals will not be permitted to join the class.
Visitors are not allowed to stay in the accommodation.
Attendance in all classes is mandatory. Leave may only be taken in cases of emergency or illness, and must be approved by the respective teacher.
Uninformed absences will not be accepted and will negatively impact the student's monthly performance.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Deposits are non-refundable, but can be transferred to other upcoming courses at Bali Yoga School in any locations. The deposit is valid for a lifetime.

issues: Hour calculation totals 60 hours (48 class + 12 self-study) but states 'Total Course Duration - 50 Hours'.
Calculation is based on 6 days, while batches run 1st to 8th of each month (8 calendar days); length in days never stated, so duration left null.
50-hour course said to give a 'Yoga Alliance accredited certificate' - Yoga Alliance registers 200/300/500-hour programs; 50-hour certification wording should be verified.
Text says 'Founded by Yogi Himanshu from Rishikesh ... has proudly shared authentic teachings with global seekers for years' - generic marketing, not used.
Original typo 'Shiva mantra aeditation' corrected to 'meditation'.

Healing add-on notes say sessions are 'Conducted during free time in your Yoga Teacher Training Course at Himalayan Yoga Association' (Rishikesh school name copied onto a Bali Uluwatu page) - location wording must be corrected before use.
Daily Time Schedule shows Breakfast 08:30 am / Lunch 12:30 pm / Dinner 19:30 pm, but Meal Timings say Breakfast 09:00-10:00, Lunch 12:00-13:00, Dinner 19:00-20:00.

Inclusions list '3 daily vegetarian / vegan meals' while Meal Timings note says 'Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays'; also the meal-free and room-free fee options conflict with blanket inclusions (meals, accommodation one day before check-in).
Daily schedule includes a 'Sound Healing Class (only applicable for YTT + Healing Course participants)' slot at 13:30-15:30.

Fee boxes show two prices (original and offer) but no discount label text on the page; currency shown only as '$'.
Teacher bios and the founder block (Yogi Himanshu) are a shared site-wide block, not specific to this course; names recorded only.
